name: Account Service
definition: Services linked to an account which are available to the account owner or to the holder of a mandate.

AccountContract.name: Account Contract
AccountContract.definition: Account contract which specifies the services linked to an account.

Reservation.name: Reservation
Reservation.definition: Reservation information included in the services related to an account.

Account.name: Account
Account.definition: Account for which services are specified.

AccountAdministrationCharge.name: Account Administration Charge
AccountAdministrationCharge.definition: Charge applied for the administration of an account.
